scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:site && npm run test:claims && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:cli: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:claims: test -x .test-venv/bin/python || (python3 -m venv .test-venv && .test-venv/bin/pip install -r examples/seeded/requirements.txt); node tests/cli-claims.mjs
scripts.test:claim: test -x .test-venv/bin/python || (python3 -m venv .test-venv && .test-venv/bin/pip install -r examples/seeded/requirements.txt); node tests/cli-claims.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --release --locked && mkdir -p dist/bin && cp target/release/switchboard dist/bin/switchboard
